name: core-pass-unplayed-sc
description: Rules audit (core): LRR 3 ACTION PHASE - a player cannot pass until they have performed the strategic action of each strategy card they hold. The original left Pass off the turn menu while a card was unplayed, but a Pass already on screen (or answered through the engine) went through. Now the bot's passForRound / passingAbilities and turn.action validate refuse it (TurnRules.passRefusal). Base: pbd1204 undo save 109 (Mentak active, holds 2 and 6, both played); Warfare (6) is un-played: Pass is refused (engine and the button itself) and Bastion's turn does not start.
